i,

〔此处转录不清〕

I am directed to refer to your letter No. 315/Int./37 dated the 1st August, 1937
and to say that the question of granting a refund of the sum of Rs. 50/- (Rupees Fifty only)
realised from you under section 6A/5/31b.5(3b) of the Indian Income-tax Act is still
under consideration.

2. I am also to say that no decision has yet been taken in the matter and that it will
be communicated to you as soon as possible.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔此处转录不清〕

Secretary to Government.

〔此处转录不清〕

〔批：be Cto Pol. Information settlement, Sd/- any comment ?〕

奉命提及贵方 1937 年 8 月 1 日第 315/Int./37 号来函，
并告知，根据《印度所得税法》第 6A/5/31b.5(3b) 条向
贵方收取的 50 卢比（仅伍拾卢比）款项之退还事宜，

尽快通知贵方。

UNITED STATES OF BRAZIL CONSULATE.

Shanghai, November 29, 1937

No. 32

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that
Mr. Akow Lam has been appointed Interpreter for
this Consulate-General as from August 1, 1937
as per per notification DA/6/313.5(863) of September
29, 1937 of my Government.

I take this opportunity to renew the
assurances of my most distinguished consideration,

Sd.

Heitor da Silveira Carneiro
Vice-Consul
In Charge of the Consulate
General.

Major F. W. Gerrard,
Commissioner of Police,
International Settlement,
Shanghai.
pages.zh:
译文。

巴西合众国领事馆。

上海，1937 年 11 月 29 日

第 32 号

先生，

谨此通知，
根据我国政府 1937 年 9 月 29 日
DA/6/313.5(863) 号通知，
Akow Lam 先生自 1937 年 8 月 1 日起
被任命为本总领事馆翻译。

借此机会，重申本人最崇高的敬意。

签署

Heitor da Silveira Carneiro
副领事
代理总领事

F. W. Gerrard 少校，
警务处处长，
上海公共租界，
上海。
